**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Chat
- **Sentences no longer run together in replies that use tools.** When the model narrates between web searches or other tool calls ("Let me check the latest reviews…", then searches, then answers), each stretch of text was glued directly onto the previous one — the next sentence started right after the period with no space. Each step is now its own paragraph, both while streaming and in the saved conversation.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.22...v8.23
